Real Java class-initialization read observed via @Deprecated { ...(read("life:class")) } in stage12-java-host-path-01; Rust annotation frontend unsupported, so actual Host-in-class cross-language reentry remains unexecuted. Internal scheduler tests are separate.
Terminal context/token/heap cleanup is covered by separate Rust lifecycle tests, not Java raw-byte equivalence.

Indirect cyclic hierarchy property traversal new A {}.missing timed out after successful class identity calls in stage12-java-observations-03; traversal is observed oracle-timeout, not a compatibility pass.

limitations: protocol bytes are not full Java diagnostics or public API compatibility
Java parses the Pkl fixtures; Rust uses explicit bytecode translations checked against exact fixture bytes, not frontend read(...) lowering
reentry uses a prewarmed resource: a new nested Java resource read inside an outer read can raise ConcurrentModificationException; that unsupported upstream edge is outside this successful protocol
native bounded VM/Host only; not browser/Node lifecycle parity
no performance or long-session memory claim
